models.why: The one LLM figure that lands on a Raspberry Pi 5: Google's own LiteRT-LM path decodes Gemma 4 E2B at 9 tok/s (99 tok/s prefill) at 1432 MB peak, and Trelis's llama.cpp b8816 build on a Pi 4 gets 1.0 tok/s decode — a hobby-board ceiling, not a laptop one.
